stemMarkdown: Students specialising in Mathematics make up what percentage of the whole college?
solutionMarkdown:
Mathematics is 20% of Science, and Science is 35% of the college, so multiply the two shares:

$0.20 \times 0.35 = 0.07 = 7\%$

Checking with headcounts: $420 \times 0.20 = 84$, and $\dfrac{84}{1200} \times 100 = 7\%$.

**7%**. Nested pies chain by multiplication, never by addition — 20% and 35% do not combine into 55% or into 20%.
